name: 4-MeO-MiPT
summary: A rare psychedelic tryptamine first synthesised by Alexander Shulgin, known as the "little brother" of 5-MeO-MiPT. There are reports of it to be mild with lighter visual effects than most tryptamines.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: It acts as a serotonin reuptake inhibitor and as a non-selective serotonin receptor agonist, including of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor.
pharmacology.kind: Non-selective serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen; Serotonin reuptake inhibitor

uses.text: The drug is taken orally. The drug was reported as a novel designer drug by 2016.

summaryZh: 4-MeO-MiPT是一種色胺衍生物，化學式為C15H22N2O，由亞歷山大·舒爾金開發，可作為致幻劑。
summaryZhHans: 4-MeO-MiPT是一种色胺衍生物，化学式为C15H22N2O，由亚历山大·舒尔金开发，可作为致幻剂。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psychedelic tryptamines, can cause nausea, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. It also blocks serotonin reuptake, which may add to serotonergic effects. In people at risk, these drugs can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的迷幻色胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。它也會阻斷血清素回收，可能使血清素相關作用更強。對本身有風險的人，這類藥物可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的迷幻色胺类药物，可能引起恶心、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。它也会阻断血清素回收，可能使血清素相关作用更强。对本身有风险的人，这类药物可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: Alexander Shulgin made it and described it in TiHKAL. It is the 4-position twin of 5-MeO-MiPT, often called moxy, differing only in where the methoxy group sits.
fact.zh: Alexander Shulgin合成了它並在《TiHKAL》中加以描述。它是5-MeO-MiPT（常被稱為moxy）的第4位雙胞胎，只差在甲氧基的位置。
fact.zhHans: Alexander Shulgin合成了它并在《TiHKAL》中加以描述。它是5-MeO-MiPT（常被称为moxy）的第4位双胞胎，只差在甲氧基的位置。
